subject: project:gdl
value: A `fndiff --classify` roster is a LABEL census, not a work queue, and on a mature TU it can overstate the remaining work by an order of magnitude: in game/sound/sounds_evt.c, 32 of 118 rows classify as non-EXACT but only 3 carry a non-zero `real`. The 29 false positives come in exactly two flavours, and BOTH are cheap to recognise before any source is read. (1) RELOCATION_ONLY (27 rows here) is the .sdata2/constant-pool NAME noise that `fndiff --clean` already suppresses and reports as `MATCH (pool-name noise only), 0 real diff lines`; it is not a residual at all. (2) OPERAND_DIFF can be produced ENTIRELY by compiler-generated switch jumptables, with an identical instruction stream on both sides: the split object relocates the table load against a named local symbol (`jumptable_801243DC`, `scope:local` in config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt) while our freshly-compiled object emits an anonymous section-relative reloc, which the differ renders as `@0x801243A8` versus `<local>` and scores as an operand difference. Both AudioTowerFX and fn_8009DB24 sit at real 0 purely for this reason, and no source change can or should close it — it is the 'verified symbol-name normalization issue' AGENTS.md already exempts from the EXACT bar. THE OPERATIONAL RULE, which costs one command: take the `defake_gate.py baseline` line ('N functions (M at real 0)') as the authoritative count of outstanding work in a TU and let it arbitrate the classify roster, or equivalently run probe.py per candidate before reading any diff — do NOT size a lane, build a queue, or estimate a session from classify labels alone. THE SAME ARTIFACT ALSO CONTAMINATES regnorm: the STRUCTURAL rows reported at 0x7c-0x80 of AudioSetupBossStreams are `jumptable_801243DC` vs `@656` reloc-annotation rows, so a jumptable in the function inflates the STRUCTURAL row count on that tool too. Diagnostic tell for the jumptable flavour, distinguishing it from a real operand gap in one glance: the differing operand is a relocation ANNOTATION line rather than an instruction line, the instruction counts are equal, and the symbol on the target side matches `jumptable_[0-9a-f]{8}`.
